column5: GROUP: Production code: | `orch/package/package_review.rs:205-207` | Required component with no candidate description skipped | not traced whether `with_independent_component_descriptions` rejects it later

GROUP: Production code: | `ba/lib.rs:201-203` (checked) | Float comparison roster checks the plan index exists but does not compare `provider_plan_commitment`; the integer sibling does (`:304`) | not traced whether the commitment is checked elsewhere
GROUP: Production code: | `cd/component_description.rs:334-336` | Missing identity becomes `""` in derived identities | a dangling identity index; not checked for emptiness

GROUP: Production code: | `nc/realization/callback_thunks.rs:507` | Body with neither installed entry nor retained plan treated as an ordinary callback body | "a handler body wrongly missing from the cohort would be emitted as an ordinary callback"; producer not traced
GROUP: Production code: | `whr/windows_handle_origins.rs:87` | `ExternalInput`/`OpaqueObservation` carry no sources | whether consumers treat them as unknown not traced

GROUP: Production code: | `pa/provider_installation.rs:219-229` | Candidates whose requirement identity matches no selected row are dropped before the missing-provider check | a catalog row for an unselected requirement is not installed; downstream coverage not read

GROUP: Production code: | `pa/provider_installation/replay.rs:66-68`, `:151-160`, `:33-52` (checked `:66-68`) | Calls to a boundary with no installed provider are not replayed; duplicate keys first-wins | whether a later consumer demands a row per call not traced

GROUP: Production code: | `pp/intrinsic_declarations.rs:314-319` (checked) | Declaration-identity comparison skipped when the accepted binding carries none | a binding with no declaration identity that matches package/path/digests; callers not traced
